species.name: Lake trout
why: Water 48°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 16–84 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 95 ft, cold below.
Clear water: they bite best at dawn, dusk and on cloudy days.

species.name: Northern pike
why: Water 48°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.

The lake is layered: warm water down to about 95 ft, cold below.
